name: Find the Cheapest Wireless Mouse on Amazon.in and Add to Cart

steps.description: Amazon.in home page — click the Search box
Type "wireless mouse" in the search box
Click the Go button to search
Select "Price: Low to High" from the Sort by dropdown
Click "See all products, across price ranges" to remove location filter

locator.text: See all products, across price ranges.

steps.description: Click "Radio Frequency" under Connectivity to filter wireless-only mice

locator.name: Apply the filter Radio Frequency to narrow results

steps.description: Click on the first result — the cheapest wireless mouse (Geonix Nimbus 03, ₹209)

locator.name: Geonix Nimbus 03 Optical Wireless Mouse, Range 10m, 4 Buttons; 2.4GHz Nano Receiver, 3 DPI Modes, 2*AA Cell, Optical Orientation, Plug & Play

steps.description: Click "Add to cart" to add the mouse to your cart
View the cart — item added successfully. Click "Go to Cart" to review without logging in
